intro.en: Eight things nobody does, at any site, for anyone. No exceptions.

why.en: One name can end the contract. Saying it, even to a site owner, is immediate termination.

never.en: Never share or recycle an account.

why.en: A shared account puts someone else's fraud on your name. A recycled one brings its ban with it.

never.en: Never deploy without ID and consent.

why.en: A minor in footage can end the contract. No ID, no device, no matter who at the site assigned them.

never.en: Never film in a restroom, locker room, prayer room, or office.

why.en: Consent covers work, not private rooms. The footage is deleted and the wearer is out the same day.
Phones live at the site, at a hub, or in a signed-for case. Anywhere else is a missing phone, and lost mode starts within the hour.
One complaint makes it a data-protection breach. A tested hub or a day-pass location, nothing else.

never.en: Never move more than a third of a site's phones at once.

why.en: One crash or theft costs a third of the site, not the site. Above 60 phones, two runners on staggered runs.

never.en: Never re-enroll a worker removed for fraud.

why.en: Not under any name or device. Their next flag lands on your site, and repeat fraud is how a contract ends.

closing.en: See one of these happening? Tell your Portfolio Manager the same day, or bring it to open office hours, 30 minutes every day. Portfolio Managers tell Moharam.
